name: The On-Set Show (With Laurence Adams)
overview: Created by actor and filmmaker Laurence Adams and starring Marcus Lubin, The On-Set Show is a cinematic talk series that dives into the untold realities of filmmaking—where the truth behind the camera is just as powerful as what’s on screen.
